analyst.summary: VBL's CY2025 growth deceleration (8.4% revenue growth vs 18.1% 3-year CAGR) traces cleanly to one bad monsoon quarter (Q2 CY2025 sales actually fell YoY per our PIT data) that hit just as ~40-45% new India capacity came online, and Q1 CY2026 already shows that reversing (16.3% volume, 18.1% revenue, 20% PAT growth). Balance sheet quality is untouched (ROE 23%, ROCE 27.4%, D/E 0.13, zero red flags) and international expansion (South Africa, DRC, Zimbabwe, Kenya) is real and funded, reducing India-weather single-market dependency. At ~50x trailing PE the stock is priced for a return to high-teens-to-20% sustained growth, a real but moderate gap versus my own ~14-15% forward estimate, and the stock has already absorbed a ~15-17% pullback from its 52-week high. Hold: the fundamentals do not support selling into an imminent (days-to-weeks) Q2 CY2026 print that could confirm the Q1 recovery, but a freshly-downgraded IMD monsoon forecast and Reliance's genuine Campa Cola share gains (duopoly share down from ~93% to ~85%) mean this is a name to watch closely, not one to add to blind.
